preconditions: The host board must provide the selected M5-Bus UART mapping.
If the module sensors are used, the corresponding I2C mapping must also be present.
steps: Open the configured UART and confirm NEO-M9N traffic is present.
Probe the module sensor I2C bus for BMI270 and BMP280 where used.
Apply board-local DIP switch assumptions for UART and PPS routing.

checks: Read GNSS serial traffic from the mapped UART.
Probe the module IMU and barometer addresses if their I2C path is wired.
Observe the mapped PPS input if present.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The GNSS UART path is alive and any wired sensor bus responds as expected.
failureNotes: Satellite lock and heading quality depend on antenna placement and environment.
The BMM150 is behind the module sensor hub and may not appear directly on the host I2C scan.
